meta.title: Adylsha Yumayev | Software Engineer — C#/.NET & Backend

hero.description: I build backend systems and APIs with C#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server, from enterprise applications to independent systems in identity, real-time platforms, and observability. Currently focused on system design and software architecture.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Backend engineer — focused on system design and architecture
about.p1: Over four years, I've worked mainly on backend systems for enterprise software — API development, database structures on SQL Server, and internal platforms supporting real business workflows. I also contributed to the architecture of my current company's first mobile application.
about.p2: Outside of work, I build backend-heavy systems that let me explore identity, distributed systems, observability, and system design in depth. My projects include YumaIdentity, an identity and access management service, YumaSnap, a real-time event platform, and YumaLog, a logging and observability library.
about.p3: I'm continuing to deepen my focus on system design, distributed systems, and software architecture.

gelecek2025.title: Gelecek Varlık Yönetimi
desc: Develop and maintain business-critical enterprise applications using C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, and SQL Server.
Design and implement backend services and REST APIs supporting internal workflows and external-facing platforms.
Design database structures and develop T-SQL queries for business-critical applications.
Designed and implemented a reverse proxy using C# and YARP to securely expose selected internal APIs to external clients.
Built a company-wide structured logging library (.NET Standard 2.0) with its own CI/CD, published as a private NuGet package on Azure DevOps Artifacts.
Added a Log Ingestion API so client applications could ship logs through the same pipeline.
Migrated large documents out of the primary database into a dedicated SQL Server database behind a new API, resolving recurring backup and storage issues.
Leading a team building an OCR → PII → analysis pipeline that turns select documents into structured Excel/JSON, automating legal document checks; chat-based querying planned next.
Contributed to the architecture and development of the company's first mobile application, working across the mobile client and backend services.
Contribute to deployment, troubleshooting, security, and modernization of existing applications.

projects.title: Projects

yumasnap.title: YumaSnap — Event Photo Sharing Platform
yumasnap.desc: A real-time photo-sharing platform for events and wedding venues. Guests scan a QR code and start uploading instantly without creating an account or installing an app. I designed the upload pipeline on Supabase and AWS S3, along with the real-time layer that keeps guest galleries synchronized as new photos arrive.

YumaIdentity.title: YumaIdentity — IAM Service
YumaIdentity.desc: An independently designed and built Identity and Access Management service for my own applications. It provides authentication, role-based authorization, and multi-tenant access control, built with ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server, JWT, and OAuth 2.0 (PKCE). The API is under active development, with the administration interface still in progress.

yumalog.title: YumaLog — Structured Logging & Observability for .NET
yumalog.desc: A structured logging library designed to provide a consistent logging approach across .NET Framework and modern .NET applications. It buffers log events asynchronously, writes structured JSON logs per application, and is designed for collection through Grafana Alloy and querying in Grafana via Loki. Distributed as a NuGet package with a test suite and configurable buffering, retention, and diagnostics.
